notes.title: Demo - v0.8.16-beta - New ranking system! Bug fixes!
notes.notes:
We have a ranking system now! 
Gives a grade based on speed of clearing the Sector and overall weapon accuracy

Shows a score breakdown per Sector

Saves your personal records



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/ede53a987f0c7e78a307a289f338f4488f8fa4e5.png"]



Bug Fixes & Improvements

Controls & UI

Fixed issues with Control Mapper (closing, restoring defaults).

Upgrade tooltips no longer clip off-screen.

Fixed navigation issues in a couple menus with controller.

Session Review screen score breakdown cleaned up and easier to read.

Audio/Visual

Level-up sound FX play correctly no longer clips intermittently

XP bar flashes at 80% fill to help show being close to leveling up.

Healbot SFX no longer plays when paused.

Shops & Upgrades

Fixed rare duplicate item purchases.

Phase Beam upgrade stat text now displays properly.

Gameplay

Ammo drops now prioritize your lowest stock (hot/cold).

Boost no longer sticks after activation.

Credit thief's movement is bit less erratic.

Tutorial

Refactored ammo collection tutorial steps to help prevent confusion around keybindings

Misc.

Map names now show in the upper right of the HUD



Cheers!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png"]

notes.title: Demo - v0.8.10-beta - Bug fixes and some vfx updates!
notes.notes:
🛠 Bug Fixes & some VFX Updates!
Fixed level-up sound cutting off when the panel appears.

Fixed ship upgrade tooltips bleeding off the screen.

Fixed “Total Circuits per Session” mod so it correctly increases the number of max circuits dropped per nebula run.

Fixed certain upgrades incorrectly showing in Active Effects UI.

Control map panel now shows non-movement buttons at the top.

XP bar now flashes at 80% fill, resets on level-up.

Added particle burst when leveling up to make it more noticeable.

Fixed shop bug allowing duplicate item purchases in certain cases where player has many credits.

Fixed intermittent shrapnel bullet pool error that would happen shrapnel enemy bullets are destroyed.



Cheers!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png"]

notes.title: Devlog - August 14, 2025 - Demo release date soon! Adding Sector VFX!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!


Planned Demo Release Date - Updated 8/28/25
Update: To add some more polish and balancing we're going to push our demo out just a bit. We're aiming for September! Thanks!

Old: We're aiming to release our demo August 29, 2025 and are super excited to get feedback! The Steam page will be up soon.


Sector VFX
We've added new themes for Sectors depending on whether or not they're hot or cold:


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/8de13bf6c625132a60eb992175863be0c013d0a3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/659667cae806acccdbe9acbce545f1f9e24ddf62.png"][/carousel]

New Trailer Soon(TM)
Along with our demo a new gameplay trailer will be uploaded! 


Bug Fixes and Improvements
Controller D-pad menu navigation in menus now supported

Hot, cold, and neutral themed maps – environments now better match their zone type.

Steam Cloud save support enabled

Shimmer fx on certain level-up choices – thermal level-up choices are now more obvious.

UI scaling overhaul – menus, HUD, and tooltips now scale properly at various resolutions

Cleaner tooltips – smaller, delayed, and less intrusive

Boss fight UI updates – smaller warnings, better health bars, and bosses can now be frozen/overheated more easily.

Pacing tweaks – faster early leveling and shorter enemy stagger times

Controller stability – PS4/PS5 controllers now connect via Bluetooth without switching input modes mid-game.

Enemy movement – mosquitos no longer jitter, and magnetic fields no longer yank wall-clinging enemies off surfaces.

Repulser blast – knockback now behaves as expected.

Shops – tightened up collision boxes with purchasable items.

Foggy maps – now actually have fog machines for better atmosphere.


One Year of Progress
We recently uploaded a video showing the progress on our game over the last year:


[previewyoutube="rCyEJRZEnt8;full"][/previewyoutube]


Cheers!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png"]

notes.title: Devlog - April 11, 2025 - The Sectors Update
notes.notes:
Major Update to Sectors

We overhauled the way Sectors are created so they're created by hand with just a touch of procedural generation. Prior to this, Sectors were mostly empty rooms with enemies spawned in at partially randomized places. 

Now, instead of having empty areas to start with we can have much more fun creating cool, challenging maps like this!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/a765c9357610e33aadc42f6ef94f278674d21472.png

Or this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/4d548b54488a785e2bf324fd6019d1f7322dcf79.png

Or this!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/7be2a6b8e6d4215201d6846a01543c0a88f8e8fc.png

New Features

Thermal Enemy Weaponry
Enemies can now fire cold, hot and neutral temperature bullets!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/6f2441ce9546650127d790e4de4093397f1397aa.gif

Thermal Shields
Your ship can now use it's current temperature to create a bullet shield! This can be used to block enemy bullets of specific temperatures. Using your bullet shield moves your ship temperature towards neutral quickly so use it wisely!

A cold shield is created when your ship temperature is chilled and a heat shield is created when your ship temperature is heated! More on this soon as we continue to polish it. 

Additional Changes

 Boost ability can now be upgraded and is used like Dash
 Shrunk the hurtboxes on player ships to make it a bit harder for the player to get hit
 Player ship temperature is no longer reset at the end of a sector so it can be carried into the next sector
 Updated bounce weaponry so it can't get stuck on the wall in some cases
 Enemies now "sleep" for just a moment when player enters so the player doesn't get attacked when portaling into a sector
 Adjusted the positioning of some player ship weapons to make them easier to use
